main_text.p: Bavarica lingua si- mi in Sue- vica.Bavarorum lingua Suevicæ similis est, sed etiam crassior, ut audio: crassissima in Austria, vel aliqua ejus parte, frow pronunciant fraw: heuw/hauw/&c.

page.notes: The German word list is set in black letter; the words in the list are marked <bl>. "Gwksen" (Gwksen) and "Wed"/"sole" are doubtful readings and may need checking against the scan. The right-hand note is set in small type and is partly cut at the line ends. Some words in the paragraph ("frow", "fraw", "heuw/hauw") may be in a different type than the surrounding roman text.
